en.t: How would you like to try some too?

units.source_text: 女人先下筷虽不洁净，不过可以成为日后的笑料呢。”

en.t: It may not be proper for a woman to take the first bite, but it will make a funny story later.

units.source_text: 阿妈说罢，从行李里取出碗筷，让百合子洗净拿来。

en.t: After saying this, the old woman took bowls and chopsticks from the luggage and had Yuriko wash them and bring them over.
